decisions.reason: The air quality sensor module fits the firm's established modular sensor platform, so it draws directly on existing hardware and firmware knowledge and can be improved in-house.
As the third generation of an existing measurement module, it builds on accumulated knowledge from earlier versions and is a core part of the product line.
A standalone MQTT proxy is a stopgap software layer that the firm's growing software expertise is likely to replace with integrated MQTT bindings, freeing resources for that approach.
The CAN bus interface module extends the firm's well-understood interface module family and benefits from its in-house communication protocol know-how.
The CO2 sensor module is a logical extension of the firm's environmental sensor portfolio, so the firm can readily interpret market feedback and refine it.
The touch panel accessory is somewhat further from the firm's core sensor and interface knowledge, but it complements the platform and has its own page, so it is kept for now.
